research.query: American Kickboxing Academy SBG Ireland corner context UFC 229
research.result: Nurmagomedov represented American Kickboxing Academy's wrestling-heavy camp, while McGregor's SBG Ireland corner emphasized striking and distance control.

The October 2018 main event was contested for the UFC lightweight title and marked McGregor's return to the Octagon.
